FX-RAIN-001.says: The settings as they start: colour #c8d8ff, density 30, spacing 24, length 20, width 1, direction 170, speed 30, seed 0, opacity 60, on the night solid. The frame is smaller than one cell of the field, so it sees few drops: none at frame 0, one long pale streak drifting a little right, at frame 3, and none again at frame 4, the rain having fallen 30 pixels a frame past it.

FX-RAIN-002.says: Spacing 4, length 5: many short drops across the frame.

FX-RAIN-003.says: Spacing 4, length 5, density 0: no cell holds a drop, so the solid is untouched at every frame.

FX-RAIN-004.says: Spacing 4, length 5, density 100: every cell holds a drop, FX-RAIN-002's among them in the same places, so every pixel is at least as rainy as there.

FX-RAIN-005.says: Spacing 4, length 5, opacity 100: FX-RAIN-002's drops at five thirds of their strength.

FX-RAIN-006.says: Spacing 4, length 5, opacity 0: the solid, untouched.

FX-RAIN-007.says: Spacing 4, length 5, width 3: FX-RAIN-002's drops thicker, every pixel at least as rainy.

FX-RAIN-008.says: Spacing 4, length 5, width 0: hairline drops, never more than half their strength, every pixel at most as rainy as FX-RAIN-002.

FX-RAIN-009.says: Spacing 4, length 0: each drop a dot, every pixel at most as rainy as FX-RAIN-002.

FX-RAIN-010.says: Spacing 4, length 5, direction 180, speed 1: falling straight down one pixel a frame, so frame 1 is frame 0 moved one pixel down, and frame 4 four; the streaks run down the columns.

FX-RAIN-011.says: FX-RAIN-010 with direction 540, a whole turn past 180: the same.

FX-RAIN-012.says: Spacing 4, length 5, direction 90, speed 0: falling to the right, the streaks run along the rows; with speed 0 frame 4 is frame 0.

FX-RAIN-013.says: Spacing 4, length 5, seed 7: drops of their own.

FX-RAIN-014.says: Spacing 4, length 5, seed 7.9, which counts as 7: FX-RAIN-013.

FX-RAIN-015.says: FX-RAIN-002 with its colour written in capitals, #C8D8FF: the same.

FX-RAIN-016.says: Spacing 4, length 5, opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the solid, frame 2 opacity 50 and frame 4 opacity 100.

FX-RAIN-017.says: Spacing 4, length 5, density keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 0 is the solid; frame 2 would pass 100, is held at 100, and is density 100 at frame 2.

FX-RAIN-018.says: FX-RAIN-002 moved three pixels right: the field is the drawing's own, so the rain moves with it, and the three columns left bare stay empty.

FX-RAIN-019.says: FX-RAIN-002 on Noise's card: the same drops, each pixel that shows mixed toward the rain as much as on the solid, the soft edge at its own half covering, and the empty column and row stay empty.

FX-RAIN-020.says: Density 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RAIN-021.says: Spacing 1, below 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RAIN-022.says: Length -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RAIN-023.says: Width 21, above 20. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RAIN-024.says: Direction 3601, past ten turns. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RAIN-025.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RAIN-026.says: A colour written "#c8d8f", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RAIN-027.says: Speed keyed to 1001 at frame 4, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
